description: Analogue wavefolder with symmetry bias, an overdrive stage and a strike input

params.text: Sets how far the input signal is folded, near silence at the bottom and a dense harmonic timbre at the top
Attenuates and inverts the wavefold CV input
In the down position the bias knob attenuverts a signal at the symmetry bias input; in the up position it sets a DC offset added to the input before folding
Sets the DC offset added to the input before folding, or scales the signal at the symmetry bias input, according to the BIAS switch; the centre is calibrated to 0V
In the up position an analogue overdrive stage soft clips the input signal
Sets the decay of the envelope that a strike fires into the wavefolder, half way by default

inputs.text: The signal to be folded, DC coupled
Modulates the folding amount through an exponential VCA, scaled by the wavefold attenuverter
Replaces the DC reference on the bias control, and sums with the input signal before the folding stage
A gate or trigger momentarily opens the wavefolder, decaying at the rate set by the strike trimmer
